## 💡 Feature Description

A clear description of the feature you'd like.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves

What pain point does this address?

## 💭 Proposed Solution

How would you implement it? Which system does it touch?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you think about?

## 📊 Priority

- [ ] Critical (blocks release)
- [ ] High (next sprint)
- [ ] Medium (when bandwidth allows)
- [ ] Low (nice-to-have)

## 🎨 Mockups / Examples

Links, sketches, reference games, etc.
